India and Israel Conclude Second Round of Free Trade Agreement Talks

India and Israel have completed the second round of negotiations for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA). The talks, held in New Delhi, focused on advancing the trade agreement between the two nations. This development marks a step forward in strengthening economic ties.
